metaTitle: Jaguar High-Mileage Engine Rebuild | Jaguar Garage
metaDescription: Specialist high-mileage engine rebuild service for Jaguar vehicles. Full disassembly, precision machining, and reassembly to factory tolerances.
lede: Comprehensive engine rebuild service for high-mileage Jaguar vehicles, restoring performance and reliability to factory standards.

blocks.html: A high-mileage Jaguar engine rebuild is a comprehensive, structured process that goes far beyond basic repairs. It restores the engine to factory specifications, addressing wear that accumulates over time and mileage.

The rebuild begins with a full assessment: every component is inspected for wear, cracks, and hidden issues. The engine is then completely disassembled, with every bolt, bearing, and gasket removed, catalogued, and cleaned. Precision cleaning using chemical baths, ultrasonic cleaners, and pressure washers eliminates sludge, carbon buildup, and debris. Oil galleries are flushed to remove deposits.

Critical parts are machined to restore exact OEM tolerances - cylinder bores are honed, crankshaft journals ground, and cylinder heads resurfaced. High-friction parts like pistons, rings, and bearings are always replaced, along with gaskets, seals, and timing components. The oil pump is inspected and either refurbished or replaced. Finally, the engine is reassembled with precision and subjected to bench testing, dyno testing, and road testing to confirm performance meets factory standards.
Our approach is matched to your specific Jaguar model and engine variant, ensuring every step is carried out to the correct specification.

steps.title: Inspection & Assessment
steps.body: We evaluate every component for wear, cracks, and hidden issues using compression and leak-down tests.

steps.title: Full Disassembly
steps.body: The engine is completely stripped, with every part catalogued and cleaned for inspection.

steps.title: Precision Cleaning
steps.body: Chemical baths, ultrasonic cleaners, and pressure washers remove sludge and deposits from all components.

steps.title: Machining & Tolerancing
steps.body: Cylinder bores are honed, crankshaft journals ground, and heads resurfaced to restore OEM tolerances.

steps.title: Parts Replacement
steps.body: All high-friction parts (pistons, rings, bearings, gaskets, timing components) are replaced with new items.

steps.title: Reassembly & Testing
steps.body: Engine is rebuilt with precision, then bench-tested, dyno-tested, and road-tested to confirm performance.

items.q: How long does a high-mileage engine rebuild take?
items.a: Typical turnaround is 3-4 weeks, depending on the extent of machining and parts availability. We provide a clear timeline during the quotation stage.

items.q: Do you offer a warranty on rebuilt engines?
items.a: Yes. All rebuilds carry our standard 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, covering parts and labour for any faults arising from our work.

items.q: Can you rebuild any Jaguar engine, regardless of mileage?
items.a: We work on all Jaguar petrol and diesel engines - from classic XK units to modern Ingenium. High mileage is not a barrier; we assess each engine individually.

items.q: What if my engine is too worn to rebuild?
items.a: If the engine is beyond economical repair, we will advise you honestly and recommend replacement or other options. Our goal is to give you the best outcome for your budget.
